My dear [Nina](/person/2352)[^1]
[Gertrude](/person/1462) desires me to say that we have never had an American edition of [the Three Brides](/book/120) but she has taken measures for getting a second hand one and it will be sent to you.

All my stories in the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52) do get published again	Gertrude is tolerably well just now

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Identified tentatively from the letter of 2 June 1883.
